integrity: The proof uses the exact bijective insertion of the largest label into a uniform permutation on one fewer label. This yields a first-order recurrence for the mixed cycle-record moment and a closed solution. An exhaustive exact-rational checker independently verifies the formulas through n=9.
scientific_limitations: The exact kernel is proved for the uniform permutation law.
Coordinatewise positive covariance does not imply full association between cycle structure and the record process.
The classical record-cycle equidistribution is prior; the claimed contribution is the same-permutation local covariance kernel and its aggregate asymptotics.
Older enumerative literature may contain an equivalent bivariate generating function.
title: Cycles and records have an exact positive local covariance kernel
